trial_probe.description: Probe the local RustXNG health endpoint.

install_plan.description: Use the RustXNG service preset after installing the managed tool-runtime binary.

services.notes: RustXNG is managed as a service runtime so local HTTP availability is tracked separately from the managed binary install (tool-runtime rustxng). AGPL-3.0-or-later: process-boundary / HTTP only. Default bind is 127.0.0.1:8888; probe GET /healthz. search-actuator provider=rustxng calls /search?format=json and may auto-start a detached loopback sidecar when this probe is down.
